title: Workstation V1 recipe
description: Ordered link actions for Workstation. The Rust parser is authoritative.

version.description: Recipe format version; currently only 1 is supported.

description.description: Optional human-readable recipe description, containing non-whitespace text.

actions.description: Link actions in execution order; an empty list is allowed.

id.description: Nonblank action identifier; must be unique within the recipe.

type.description: Action kind; currently only link is supported.

conflict.description: How to handle existing destination entries; defaults to error.
